input_data.message: Integration project to connect multiple enterprise systems for a manufacturing company. The integration will enable real-time data synchronization between ERP (SAP), CRM (Salesforce), and inventory management (Oracle) systems. Deliverables:  - API gateway for centralized system access - Data transformation and mapping logic - Real-time event-driven synchronization using message queues - Error handling and retry mechanisms - Monitoring dashboard for integration health - Data validation and reconciliation processes - Authentication and security layer  The integration must process 100,000+ transactions daily with 99.9% uptime, handle peak loads during business hours, and maintain data consistency across all systems.
